How does the Clinic Assistant work for $500 MXN a month?

It is a complete monthly subscription that gives your clinic or medical practice a 24/7 intelligent assistant and a professional medical website. The assistant serves patients through messaging and the web, answers common questions, books appointments in your calendar, and sends automatic reminders so no patient misses a visit.
What happens if a patient has a sensitive medical question or an emergency?

The assistant is trained to recognize ethical and medical boundaries. It answers operational questions (consultation fees, location, preparation for tests, opening hours) and, for any critical symptom or specific medical request, immediately directs the patient to the emergency hotline or the responsible doctor's direct contact.
How is the website's .com domain managed?

Your clinic's website is fully included and hosted as part of the service. If you want your website to use your own custom domain name (for example www.tucapaclinicamedica.com or .mx), registration has an optional additional annual cost that we can manage and connect for you.
Are there minimum terms or cancellation penalties?

No. The subscription is monthly and you can cancel at any time without penalties. We are confident in the value it brings to your practice: just one after-hours appointment saved by the assistant can pay for the $500 MXN monthly fee many times over.
What types of clinics or practices is it designed for?

It is optimized for dental clinics, dermatology practices, physiotherapy clinics, gynecology, nutrition, psychology, pediatrics, aesthetic medicine, and multi-specialty clinics seeking better organization and more patients.
